population: All detectable top-level questions in the supplied B volume; filename 660 is not an audited item count.
stages: Local OCR with PDF-page, image and parser hashes; original unchanged
Separate question stems, subquestions and reference answers with block coordinates
Audit numbering continuity, cross-page boundaries, formula OCR and missing material
Flag explicit textbook references and near-duplicate stems before grouped splitting
Freeze reviewed stems and answer labels before live model calls
Run retrieval baselines, then paired generation with blinded teacher review

split.assignment: sha256(source_sha256 + family_id) modulo 5; zero is development
split.test_exposure_policy: Once results are used to tune the system, relabel that subset development and reserve untouched families.

labels.relevance: 0 unrelated, 1 shared topic, 2 useful method/example, 3 exact or near-identical full conditions; null means unreviewed
labels.math_correctness: Teacher assigns pass/fail/partial against independently checked reference; model agreement is not a gold label.
labels.citation_support: Teacher confirms each cited passage supports the associated statement, beyond matching IDs.

report_rules: Use actual extracted and reviewed counts, not the title's nominal 660.
Keep scan OCR and corrected-text retrieval results separate.
Answer labels never enter retrieval, model prompt or question rewriting.
Report denominators, excluded cases, source overlap and pending reviews.
Do not equate retrieved candidates, valid citations or passed software tests with mathematical accuracy.
Do not attribute API Qwen-plus measurements to a local Qwen model.
